'''Salt water''' was [[Water/Legends|water]] with a high [[Salt/Legends|salt]] content. It was common in oceans and seas. The [[Zeffliffl (species)|Zeffliffl]] had to periodically spray salt water over themselves when they left the oceans of their homeworld.
